standard_prerequisites.name: UR-finiteness characterization
standard_prerequisites.use: Condition (2) expands (gamma) into the covering-family form.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of universal boundedness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-base-change-universally-bounded (same chapter, NOT carded, declared external)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives bounded fibres of V x_Y X -> X in the delta case.

core_obligations: (beta): X_y = Spec(k) x_Y X is a scheme; compose the monomorphisms Spec(k') -> X_y -> X.
(gamma): U_i = V_i x_Y X are etale over X and cover it; (U_i)_x = (V_i)_y x_{Spec(k)} Spec(k') and (U_i x_X U_i)_x = (R_i)_y x_{Spec(k)} Spec(k') are finite over k'.
(delta): the base-change lemma bounds V x_Y X -> X; the U-universally-bounded lemma closes.
(epsilon): the projections U_i x_X U_i -> U_i are base changes of quasi-compact projections, hence quasi-compact.
proof_roadmap: Five cases: monomorphism composition; covering-family pullback with fibre computation; boundedness transfer; projection stability; citation.
difficulty_reason: The gamma case with its two displayed base-change computations is the substance; the rest are transfer applications.
